contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus. House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constans (333-350). Obverse description: Diademed and draped bust right. Angular edges; possibly clipped, truncating legend. Obverse inscription: (--)NT(--) Reverse description: Two victories facing each other. Reverse inscription: (---)AVGGQ[NN] Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.45mm, Weight: 1.05gms, die…
